chunks: From him, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man for whom tawaf is performed and for whom the stoning is done. He said: Yes, if he is unable.

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man under discussion, meaning the person affected by the ruling
key_terms.عَنْهُ: on his behalf, indicating deputized performance of the rite
key_terms.لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ: he is unable, meaning lacking the ability to perform the rite himself
key_terms.يُرْمَى: the stoning is carried out, referring to the ritual casting at the jamarat
key_terms.يُطَافُ: tawaf is performed, referring to circumambulation in hajj rites

ai.seo_question: Can tawaf and stoning be performed for a sick person who is unable during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning an ill or incapacitated person during hajj rites. It states that tawaf may be performed with him, and the stoning may be done on his behalf, if he is unable.
